senses.gloss: f. pl. (putealia, or puteana) enclosures surrounding a well, protected cisterns (in Noah’s ark).
units: <cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 23:1">Pirké d’R. El. ch. 23</cite>, expl.
<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 23:1">ib.</cite> <he>המכסים את אמות המים וכ׳</he> (not <he>והמכניסים</he>) which cover the wells and can be opened and closed.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 6:14">Targ. Y. Gen. VI, 14</cite> <he>אַפּוֹטְנִיוּתָא</he> (<he>נְיָיתָא</he> …?). Tosef. Erub. XI (VIII), 7 <he>כלי אפוטני</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>אב׳ כלים</he>, in oth. ed. omitted) tools for unlocking the puteal.
